label: Talking head
description: A direct-to-camera presentation. Reference audio steers the voice. There is no unchanged-audio guarantee.

sections.title: No Words On Screen
sections.template: Do not add captions, titles, logos or other generated words on screen.

sections.title: Dialogue
sections.template: Say "{{dialogue}}". Use the same words, same number of words, same order.

sections.title: Subjects and Relationships
sections.template: Keep the referenced person recognizable and interacting naturally with the setting.

sections.title: Scale and Proportion
sections.template: Keep human anatomy, objects and surroundings at realistic proportions.

sections.title: Lighting
sections.template: Use believable, consistent light that suits the setting.

sections.title: Performance
sections.template: Speak naturally with restrained gestures and expressions.

sections.title: Event Script
sections.template: Start with an attentive look, deliver the dialogue, then settle naturally.

sections.title: Audio
sections.template: Reference audio steers the voice. There is no unchanged-audio guarantee.

sections.title: Maintain Consistency
sections.template: Maintain identity, wardrobe, setting and lighting throughout.
